audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Singed level 6, first item and two-plus items, while the whys directly underneath those rows say 'the 1v1 is over', 'she 1v1s you cleanly every time' and 'never by dueling her'. Level 1 is also marked Singed while its own why says both champions are too weak to fight. And the full layer is labelled FAV at 4/10 with a green tone on a 49.8% matchup.
audit.why: 49.8% Emerald+ means Singed is very slightly behind overall. The prose is right about the shape — Singed owns the pre-6 window against a melee Kayle and loses everything after her ranged form — so only the sides and the difficulty label are wrong.
audit.corrected: Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle, difficulty 6/10, EVEN with the amber tone rather than the favoured green.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] tells you that at level 2 'Kayle still has Divine Judgment — she uses it the moment you commit'. Kayle cannot have her ultimate before level 6.
audit.why: This inverts the one window Singed actually owns. Levels 2-5 are Kayle at her weakest: melee, no ultimate, and no answer to being glued and flung. Telling the player to fear an ability that does not exist costs them the only kill pressure in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-5 are the free window. Divine Judgment arrives at 6 on 160/120/80 — 160s at first rank, so even after 6 there is a long gap you can play into.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions are missing and one number is stated as if it never changes. (a) Radiant Blast reduces resistances on everything it hits, so armour and MR are a taxed answer here. (b) Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s, and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — that is the direct counter and the content layer never says so. (c) mid says Divine Judgment cancels your all-in 'every 160 seconds'; it is 160/120/80.
audit.why: Riot Radiant Blast: 'slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.' Riot Celestial Blessing: 'Kayle heals and grants Move Speed', 15s flat. Riot Divine Judgment cooldown: 160/120/80. Riot Insanity Potion: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.' The full layer already lists anti-heal as core itemisation without ever saying which ability it answers.
audit.corrected: Name Celestial Blessing as the thing Grievous Wounds beats, note the Radiant Blast shred against a resistance build, and give the ult's real 160/120/80 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing flags Starfire Spellblade as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Kit flag autoReset on E, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s. In her melee phase the reset is the wind-up tell that a real trade is starting — the cue to step off rather than the cast itself.
audit.corrected: Recorded here; the length-locked early field had higher-value corrections to carry this pass.

edits.before: Fling comes online but Kayle still has Divine Judgment — she uses it the moment you commit, eating your Fling and walking away free while you stand in the open. Trade only if you can bait the ult first.
edits.after: Fling comes online and Divine Judgment does not exist until level 6 — this is the cleanest window you get all game. Glue her feet, Fling her back under your tower, and trade while she is still melee.

edits.before: Once Kayle hits level 6 the lane shifts decisively in her favour — she is now ranged, has Divine Judgment to cancel your all-in every 160 seconds, and can auto-attack at you from outside Poison Trail range. Your Insanity Potion spike at 6 does give you a stat bump but it does not solve the fundamental problem that she shoots you from where you cannot reach her. Use Ghost and your Insanity Potion to proxy behind her tower and crash the wave repeatedly — force her to either recall or stand and soak your Mega Adhesive while you backdoor under tower. Every second she is in lane dealing with your proxy is a second she is not farming toward Nashor's Tooth.
edits.after: Once Kayle hits level 6 the lane shifts decisively in her favour — she is now ranged, and Divine Judgment cancels your all-in on 160s at first rank, falling to 80s by rank 3. Insanity Potion is still worth pressing: Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds under it, which is the only thing you own that cuts her 15s Celestial Blessing heal. Do not answer her with flat resistances either — Radiant Blast shreds them on every hit. Use Ghost and the ult to proxy behind her tower and crash repeatedly, forcing her to recall or stand and soak Mega Adhesive. Every second she spends answering your proxy is a second she is not farming toward Nashor's Tooth.

edits.before: Use Divine Judgment to negate your Fling all-in commitment — burn your E on an invulnerable target and then trade freely
edits.after: Spend Divine Judgment on your Fling commit — it is 160s at rank 1, so one bait buys you a very long free window

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment lands at 6 on 160s and she goes ranged — stop looking for the duel and make ult-ghost-proxy your entire game from here.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's outpaces your Rylai's — she autos through the cloud from outside it. Proxy; never force the side duel.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items and she kills you cleanly 1v1. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close on the map, never in a side-lane duel.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. You own the lane until 6; after that it is decided by how ruthlessly you proxy instead of duel.

edits.after: Yours until 6, hers after. See the chart below for the exact swings.

edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.

notes: The packet's levelChart for kayle (Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle) gives Kayle levels 3-5. I did not follow it there: the content layer's own early text says Kayle is 'melee and fragile before level 6 — this is the only window where you can even threaten a kill', and her kit has no ultimate and no ranged form until 6. Giving her 3-5 would contradict the page's own prose and the kit. Everything from level 6 on I did flip to Kayle, which is where the packet, the win rate and the prose all agree. The full layer also refers to Kayle as 'him'/'he' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.late — champion-level gender pass needed.
